$comment: Performance budgets (#108), checked by `npm run budgets` in CI's budgets job. Raise a number only in a pull request that says why. Kernel and viewport baselines are a CI runner's own medians (2 to 3 times a laptop's); the check fails when a median is over its baseline by more than the tolerance. totalJs went from 824 to 826 for Remove duplicates in sketches: main was at about 822.6, and the finder is a 2.7 KB chunk that loads only when you run it. totalJs went from 896 to 900 for Auto dimension (#566) and drawings that follow the model (#568): about 2.3 KB and 2.1 KB in the drawing chunk, loaded only when a drawing opens (the ranked list of sizes and its card; re-stacking rows after a model change and the warnings for lost marks and dimensions); the shell grows 0.6 KB for the two commands and the problem count on the browser row, and stays under its cap at 398.2. The Drawing workspace has its own line from #570: its chunk is 34.3 KB with release 1 in it, and 45 leaves room for release 2 (section views, more sheets, notes, a parts list) before anyone has to look again. totalJs went from 900 to 906 for more than one sheet in a drawing (#572): 3 KB in the drawing chunk (the strip of sheets, moving a view between sheets and a PDF with a page per sheet), and 0.4 KB in the shell for which sheet is open; the shell stays under its cap at 398.2. totalJs went from 906 to 912 for section, detail and broken views (#571): 6.8 KB in the drawing chunk (hatching, cutting a view's curves to a circle or round a break, the three tools' card and what they draw on the parent view), 1 KB in the kernel worker for the cut, and nothing in the shell, which is at 398.0. The drawing chunk is at 44.1 of 45: the next part of release 2 should move Export and its writers to their own chunk rather than raise the line. totalJs went from 912 to 918 for notes, symbols and tolerances on drawings (#573): about 7 KB, all of it in the drawing chunks, which load only when a drawing opens. Export and the tolerance card moved to chunks of their own so the drawing chunk stays under its 45 KB. The drawing line went from 45 to 50 and totalJs from 918 to 924 for the parts list, balloons and Make drawings of every part (#574): 3.8 KB that the sheet needs to draw the table and number the balloons, and a 1 KB chunk for the command that loads when you run it. The drawing line now counts the drawing chunk and every chunk it imports outright, less the shell's, so splitting it cannot hide growth. totalJs went from 924 to 930 for your own title block and drawing templates (#575): main was at 921.6, and the set-up card with its logo, fields and templates is now a 6 KB chunk of its own that loads only when you open New drawing or Sheet settings (taking it out of the drawing workspace keeps that under its 50). totalJs went from 930 to 931 for the admin console's sign-ins and projects (#601): main was at about 929.4, and the admin page lives in the lazy pages chunk that only #/admin and the other pages load. The shell went from 400 to 402 and totalJs from 944 to 970 for the electronics workspace (#607): main was at 399.8 and 943.4. The schematic, the board, their cards, the design's own code (nets, the change list, the starter parts) and the views' shortcuts are one chunk that loads the first time a view opens, about 22 KB, with its own Electronics workspace line at 26; later phases (the library, checks, routing, manufacturing files) go in chunks of their own. At first paint the shell gains about 1.8 KB: thirteen icons and their colour drawings for the Electronics tab and tools, the sixteen board and schematic colours in three themes, the tab, the two commands that open a view, the browser's Electronics rows and the small view-state store they all share. totalJs went from 1010 to 1016 and the drawing workspace from 52 to 54 for Edit in model (#564): main was at 1010.2 and 51.0, and the size-to-model lookup (0.9 KB) and the size properties panel (0.9 KB) are chunks of their own that load when you use them; sharing the dimension code with that panel split it into a chunk the workspace still loads, which is the other 1 KB. totalJs went from 1016 to 1018 for exploded drawing views (#574): the Explode field and its note in the view's properties chunk and the kernel worker's moving of each group (about 0.7 KB, all in lazy chunks; the shell did not change), on top of half, stepped and slanted sections, which had left 0.7 KB of room.

bundle.$comment: KB gzipped, per chunk. The shell is the JavaScript index.html loads before first paint. totalJs went from 600 to 620 in #312: main was already at 601.9 after the text tool (#309) added fonts (glyphs, 50 KB, loaded only when you place text), alongside the path tracer (63 KB, loaded only for Render); the shell cap is what guards first paint. The shell went from 355 to 358 in #310: main was at 354.6, and dragging an arm by its tool point (#176) adds 1.2 KB of glue (the tool marker, the palette commands, the lock toggle) after its solver and drag moved to a lazy chunk. 358 to 361 in the clash check (#178): main was at 357.9, and the check adds 0.8 KB (its state, the overlap boxes, the command); its list and the kernel work load later. What's new (#319) adds 0.4 KB (the Help entry, the command and the hook); the notes, the seen list, the card and the dialog load later. totalJs went from 620 to 630 with named poses (#177): main was at 618.1 and they add 1.9 KB; everything past first paint loads on use. The shell went from 355 to 356 when dragging into components (#334) added 1.1 KB (drop onto a row in the tree, the Move into menu, the moves saved with the model) to a main at 354.5. totalJs went from 630 to 632 with components (#171): main was at about 629.3 after the shell trim (#332) split code into lazy chunks, and components add 1.0 KB (the nested browser, the active component, two icons). The shell went from 361 to 362 for dropping a sketch point on another point or a line to join it (#326): main was at 360.7, and the drag glue adds 0.4 KB (the snap while dragging, the coincident on drop); finding what it drops on loads with the sketch. The clash sweep (#179) adds 0.1 KB (its command and the panel props); the sweep, its state and the mesh test load later. totalJs went from 632 to 636 for the Parameters dialog with Model parameters: main was at about 631.6, and the dialog's chunk grows by about 2.5 KB (the steps' sizes, the filter, the comment column); it loads only when Parameters opens, and the shell moves 0.3 KB. Revolve's axis pick (#342) took the shell from 357 to 358 and totalJs from 639 to 642: main was at the shell cap, and the step's axis state, the axis button and help add about 0.5 KB at first paint after the picking itself (axisPick) and Construct's pick geometry (pickGeo) moved to lazy chunks; the rest loads with the Revolve tool. #320 took the shell to under 355 and the cap back to 355: the move gizmo (TransformControls), the catalogue's parts list, file import and the problem report's zip code now load after first paint. totalJs went from 637 to 639 for the tips card (#340): main was at about 636.8, and the card and its tips add 1.3 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when it shows; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the hook, the Help entry, the bulb icon). Pattern of features (copy a hole or stub onto the same body, round a construction axis, #343) took the shell from 358 to 359 and totalJs from 642 to 644: main was at about 357.2 and 641.1, and it adds 0.8 KB to the shell (copying ops with moves in the kernel document, the axis pick, the step picked on the timeline, the release note) and about 0.8 KB more in the kernel worker (the same document code) and the lazy Pattern bar. totalJs went from 644 to 650 for the build steps export (#348): main was at about 644.2, and the export adds 4.5 KB in its own chunk (the instructions, the offscreen step pictures, the zip), loaded only when you pick Build steps; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the menu entry and the command). The origin's X, Y and Z axes in the browser (#350) took the shell from 359 to 360: main was at about 358.5, and the three rows, their eyes, the axis colours and picking them for Pattern and Joint add about 0.5 KB of glue in the editor and the view. totalJs went from 650 to 652 for the tall feature panels: main was at about 649, and the panel (rows, pickers with an ×, tick boxes, folding) adds about 1.1 KB in a chunk that loads with the first tool; the shell does not move. totalJs went from 652 to 654 for faster extrude dragging: main was at about 651.0, and it adds about 1.1 KB (the ghost the drag draws, in the lazy arrow chunk, and the kernel worker keeping each body part way through its steps); the shell does not move. totalJs went from 656 to 659 for one panel for joints: main was at about 656, and the joint panel (both components with their snaps, the line-up and motion fields) and lining a component up on its joint (the move maths, in the shell's document code and again in the kernel worker) add about 1.7 KB; the tool and its panel load on first use, so the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 659 to 663 for topological naming (#47): main was at about 659, and naming faces and edges through each step adds about 2 KB to the kernel worker (and the Properties panel now loads in its own chunk, which took the shell from 359.9 to 358.3). totalJs went from 663 to 665 for the performance overlay (#42): main was at about 662.2 after rebuild progress (#364), and the overlay (its graph, the kernel step timings) now loads in its own chunk when turned on, which costs about 0.8 KB in all; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 665 to 667 when main reached 665.2 after the alpha note (#368), sketches moving with their component (#369), round-edge joint snaps (#367) and the one-row timeline (#370) landed together, about 2 KB between them; the shell stays under its cap. Saved section analyses took the shell from 360 to 361: main was at about 359.3, and the Analysis folder, its eyes and menu, the Section tool editing a saved one and the document code for them add about 0.9 KB of glue in the browser and the view. totalJs went from 667 to 670 for snapping sketches to the model and the loupe that shows the view: main was at about 666.6, and they add about 2 KB in two chunks that load on first use (the model's snap targets when you first draw, the loupe's renderer when it first opens); the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 670 to 672 for the admin console: main was at about 669.6, and the page (every user and their models) adds about 1.5 KB to the pages chunk, which loads only off the editor; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the route and the menu entry). Fillets where faces pinch to a point (#377) and cleaner cuts on curved faces (#379) add about 0.9 KB to the kernel worker (the local round: the solid side of each face, the piece carved off and put back; the fuzzy boolean set-up) and their release notes, leaving main at about 671.3; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 672 to 675 for joint snap points (#383, #384): main was at about 671.4, and finding a face's snap points and drawing them (round dots, the hovered one's axes) add about 2.3 KB to the joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the pale hover face and its tokens). totalJs went from 675 to 677 for the joint loupe (#385, #386, #387): main was at about 673.7, and the loupe over crowded joint snaps, its close hint and the Settings switch add about 1.9 KB in the Joint tool's chunk; the shell went from 361 to 362 for it: main was at about 360.8, and the Settings switch and the sketch's check of it add about 0.3 KB at first paint (a lazy-loaded switch could not load offline from the cached app, so it stays in Settings). totalJs went from 677 to 679 for sharp corners behind rounds and bevels (#389) and the middle between two picks (#388): main was at about 675.6, and finding the cut-away corners, drawing them dashed and the Shift-click middle add about 1.3 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the view now gives each face's edge numbers (Engine.faceEdgeIds, about 0.1 KB at first paint). totalJs went from 679 to 682 for Send to kevsrobots: main was at about 678.5, and the dialog (pick or make a project, send, update) and the projects.kevsrobots.com client add about 2.6 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when you pick Send to kevsrobots; the shell moves 0.2 KB (the menu entry, the command and the link saved in the model). totalJs went from 682 to 685 for lining up hole patterns (#393) and snaps on imported meshes (#395): main was at about 681.8, and matching the holes and the mesh box snaps add about 1.4 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (Engine.bodyBox). totalJs went from 685 to 687 for turning a circle pattern round an edge picked on the model: main was at about 685, and picking the edge or round face adds about 0.5 KB in its own chunk, loaded on the first pick; the shell moves 0.4 KB (the Pattern tool's pick step and the kept axis). The shell went from 366 to 368 and totalJs from 698 to 702 for picking the parts of overlapping sketch shapes: main was at 365.7 and 697.9, and cutting curves where they cross (with tangent touches and projected face edges) is part of finding regions, which the document code the editor builds with runs on every extrude, so it cannot load later; about 1.7 KB at first paint and the same again in the kernel worker. The shell went from 368 to 369 for where an extrude starts (profile plane, offset or object): main was at 367.4, and working out the start is in the document code the editor builds with, about 0.6 KB at first paint; the Start row, its picking and the arrow's start load with the Extrude panel and arrow. totalJs went from 702 to 704 for it: main was at about 701.6, and the same start code is in the kernel worker too. Showing only the active component's steps on the timeline adds about 0.5 KB at first paint (the filter, its toggle, stepping between the steps shown) and 0.4 KB more in its own chunk (finding the steps); main was at about 703.2, so totalJs went from 704 to 705 for it. totalJs went from 705 to 707 for tracks running round their wheels: main was at about 704.1, and sliding the pieces round the loop as a wheel turns adds about 1 KB in its own chunk, loaded only for a model with a track, plus 0.2 KB at first paint (the built track list and the editor glue). totalJs went from 707 to 709 for joint snaps on imported meshes: main was at about 705.8, and growing the flat or curved run of triangles under the pointer into a face with its snaps adds about 1.6 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (Engine.bodyMesh). The shell went from 369 to 370 for colour cycling (Shift+N): main was at 368.8, and the toggle has to be at first paint (the command and its key, the view style menu entry, the view recolouring each part by its component), about 0.3 KB; there is nothing in it to load later. totalJs went from 709 to 722 for turning an imported STL's holes into Hole steps (#437): main was at about 708.6, and the recogniser (welding the mesh, flat faces, round rims, hole walls) is about 7 KB in a chunk the kernel worker loads when the tool first runs, the tool's panel and rim overlay about 3.9 KB in a chunk loaded when it opens, and the Convert step (filling the chosen holes, a hole's own head size) is in the document code the editor builds with and again in the kernel worker, about 0.7 KB at first paint with the command, the menu entry and the import hint; the shell stays under its cap at 369.7. The shell went from 370 to 371 for import progress: main was at 369.7, and the progress toast, knowing when an import's mesh is on show and drawing an STL from its own triangles until then add about 0.4 KB at first paint; reading the file and making that mesh load with the import code. totalJs went from 722 to 725 for it: main was at about 721.5, and reading an STL or 3MF in the app as well as in the kernel worker, and the worker's import progress, add about 1.8 KB, all but the shell's part loaded on the first import. The shell went from 371 to 372 and totalJs from 725 to 728 for rigid groups and STEP layouts: main was at about 370.2 and 724.9, and the Rigid group step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (the parts it carries when a joint lines one up, fixing its components to the jointed one for poses and URDF, a Move of them as one) and in the view (the move gizmo carrying the locked parts), about 1.5 KB at first paint and the same document code again in the kernel worker; making a group and recording its moves load on first use. The shell went from 373 to 375 and totalJs from 733 to 740 for Sweep (#400): main was at about 372.7 and 731.8, and the Sweep step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (its shapes, putting the path's lines and arcs end to end, its size and summary), with the tool button, its icon and the editor glue, about 1.7 KB at first paint; the tool and its panel load in their own chunk when you pick Sweep, and the document code and the sweep itself are in the kernel worker too. The shell went from 375 to 377 and totalJs from 740 to 744 for ellipses (#401): main was at 374.6 and 739.3, and an ellipse is a sketch curve like a circle, so the solver rules for its axes, finding regions round it and where it crosses lines and curves, picking and drawing it, and the Ellipse tool are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 2.3 KB at first paint; the same regions and the ellipse edges are in the kernel worker too. The shell went from 377 to 379 and totalJs from 744 to 746 for centre and tangent arcs (#405): the branch measures 377.9 and 744.1, and the Arc tool's kinds (the kind buttons, the centre and tangent previews, which way a tangent arc turns, a line carrying on tangent from an arc) are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 1 KB at first paint; there is no lazy sketch tool chunk to put them in. totalJs went from 746 to 749 for Split body (#406): main was at 743.9, and the Split step is in the document code the editor builds with and again in the kernel worker (the step, its halves, the plane's tool box), about 1.5 KB, with the tool and its panel in their own chunk, loaded when you pick Split body; the shell moves 0.6 KB (the step's document code, the tool button and icon). The shell went from 379 to 380 and totalJs from 749 to 751 for sketch mirror (#267): main was at 378.4 and 748.7, and mirroring shapes across a line (the copies, their Symmetric ties, the shared points on the line), the Mirror tool, its pick bar and its release note are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 0.9 KB at first paint; there is no lazy sketch tool chunk to put them in. totalJs went from 751 to 752 for extend and trim by dragging (#270): main was at about 750.9, and they add about 0.8 KB; they, and Mirror before them, now load in their own chunk (@bettercad/sketch/edits) when Mirror or Trim is picked, which took the shell back to 379.3. The shell went from 380 to 384 and totalJs from 752 to 759 for splines (#269): the branch measures 383.4 and 758.6 over 379.3 and 751.7, and a spline is a sketch curve like an ellipse, so fitting it through its points, its end tangents, finding regions round it and where it crosses lines and curves, trimming it, picking and drawing it, and the Spline tool are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 4.1 KB at first paint; the kernel worker turns it into a B-spline edge, about 0.7 KB more. totalJs went from 759 to 760 for offsetting whole outlines (#266): main was at 758.6, and offsetting both ways or a whole closed shape from a click inside it add about 0.6 KB to the lazy @bettercad/sketch/edits chunk, loaded when Offset is picked; the shell moves 0.5 KB (one distance for all of an offset's sizes, a copied circle that follows its original, the Both sides button). The shell went from 384 to 385 and totalJs from 760 to 761 for Offset face (#264): main was at 383.9 and 759.6, and the step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (its type, label and summary) and the tool on the top bar with its icon and the Finish tool's face picks, about 0.4 KB at first paint; its panel loads with the Finish panel, and the offset itself (the slab cut by the faces round it) is in the kernel worker, about 0.9 KB. The shell went from 383 to 385 and totalJs from 768 to 776 for the desktop ribbon and colour tool icons: main was at 382.8 and 767.5, and the ribbon's tab row (sharing the top bar's buttons), the tool bar setting and its media query, the Library and Catalogue commands, the drop-down pins and Icon loading the colour set on first use add about 1.4 KB at first paint; the ribbon's groups (1.6 KB) and the colour icons (3.9 KB) load in their own chunks after first paint, and the Sketch tab adds about 0.6 KB to the sketch chunk. Timeline marks and component colours fit under the caps (totalJs 778.9 of 780, the shell 384.9 of 385): marking the picked body's steps and barring each step in its component's colour add about 0.6 KB at first paint (the timeline's marks and bars, the editor glue, the colour cycle's hues shared with the view) and 0.4 KB more in the component steps chunk, which loads only when a body is picked or the model has components. totalJs went from 780 to 787 for canvases (#248): main was at 778.9, and canvases load in their own chunks when the Canvas tool is picked or the first canvas shows (the tool, picking a plane, reading the picture, dragging, calibrating from two spots, its panel and the drawing, about 6 KB); the Decal and Gear tools now load with their panels too, as Loft and Sweep do, which takes about 0.5 KB off the shell. totalJs went from 787 to 788 for picking construction and origin planes in Construct (Midplane between two planes): main was at 786.5, and finding the plane under the pointer (in front of a face, or by its border through a body) is 0.5 KB in its own chunk, loaded with the first plane pick; the shell moves 0.4 KB (the engine's plane list, taking a browser row as a pick, the release note). The shell went from 393 to 394 and totalJs from 834 to 841 for the sketch Pattern tool (#548): the shell carries 0.9 KB of glue (the tool, its state and Esc layers, pattern-aware solve and delete), and the pattern code, its panel and its actions (about 6 KB) load with a sketch. totalJs went from 841 to 842 for right-click and picking several models in My models: main was at about 840.5, and the card menus, the selection, its bar and Undo add about 0.7 KB to the pages chunk, which loads only off the editor; the shell does not grow. The shell went from 394 to 395 and totalJs from 842 to 843 for lifting a jointed assembly onto the floor: the branch measures 394.2 and 842.8, and moving a component now carries the components jointed to it and their joint origins, which has to be in the document code the editor builds with (and again in the kernel worker), about 0.3 KB at first paint; the floor note and Lift button load with the Joint tool. A tighter Fit (fitting the model's outline into the clear area, in both projections, for a selection, print checks and thumbnails) adds about 0.5 KB to the view at first paint and fits under these caps at 394.5. totalJs went from 843 to 845 for Insert a file (STL, STEP or 3MF into the open model as a component): main was already over at 843.4 after the tighter Fit, and the insert path (the hidden file input, its command and ribbon pin, the component made with the import, the file buttons in Insert model and My models) adds about 0.7 KB, 0.3 KB of it at first paint, which stays under the shell cap at 394.9. totalJs went from 845 to 847 for upload progress: main was at about 844.1 after Insert a file, and the upload card (each file's stage and bar, why one failed, Close) and the engine's start progress add about 1.7 KB to the pages and upload chunks, which load only off the editor; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 847 to 853 for drawing views (#558): the kernel worker's flat-view code (hidden-line removal read out as lines, arcs, circles and ellipses, joined, de-duplicated and traced back to model edges) is a 5.7 KB chunk the worker loads the first time a drawing asks for a view, never at first paint; the shell stays at 394.9. shell went from 395 to 397 and totalJs from 853 to 860 for the Drawing workspace (#559): the shell had 0.1 KB left, and a drawing needs to be reachable before its code loads, which is about 1.1 KB at first paint (the New drawing, Fit sheet, Sheet settings and Finish drawing commands and the drawing scope that puts modelling shortcuts to sleep under a sheet, the Drawings rows and their menu in the browser, the ribbon button and its colour icon, and the editor state that swaps the 3D view for the sheet). The sheet itself, its layout, title block, set-up card and page sizes are a 6.2 KB chunk loaded the first time a drawing opens. totalJs went from 860 to 862 for sketch Break, Extend and Sketch scale: Break and Scale live in the lazy edits chunk, and their glue (palette entries, pointer handling, the Scale field) adds 0.5 KB to the shell, which stays under 397. totalJs went from 862 to 868 for base views (#561): the drawing chunk grows by about 4.3 KB (turning the kernel's curves into lines on paper, the Base view card and its ghost, moving, editing and deleting a view, the Drawing ribbon tab), loaded only when a drawing opens; the shell grows 0.4 KB for the Base view command and the tab's slot in the top bar, and stays under its cap at 396.7. totalJs went from 868 to 872 for projected views (#562): the drawing chunk grows by about 2.6 KB (which view each side of a parent gives in first and third angle, keeping views lined up and carried with their parent, the Projected view card), loaded only when a drawing opens; the shell grows 0.1 KB for the Projected view command and stays under its cap at 396.8. totalJs went from 872 to 880 for drawing export (#569): about 8.5 KB, all loaded only when a drawing opens or an export runs (the export card and the sheet as plain lines in the drawing chunk, and the SVG, PDF and DXF writers, text outlines and PNG and print helpers as chunks of 1 to 3 KB each that load on the first export). The PDF writer is our own, about 1.3 KB, rather than a library. shell went from 397 to 399 with it: main was at 397.0 of 397 once the sketch roll-back fix landed, and the Export drawing command (its name, search words and the editor's hand-off to the save picker) is 0.1 KB that has to be at first paint like every other command, so the shell is 397.1. The 2 KB is room for the rest of the drawing commands in release 1 (marks, dimensions, Auto dimension); their code stays in the drawing chunk. totalJs went from 880 to 886 for centre marks and centre lines on drawings (#563): about 5.3 KB in the drawing chunk, loaded only when a drawing opens (mark geometry, the pick layer, the mark card, the Geometry group on the Drawing tab and marks in exports); the shell grows 0.3 KB for the five mark commands and stays under its cap at 397.4. totalJs went from 886 to 893 for dimensions on drawings (#564): about 6.2 KB in the drawing chunk, loaded only when a drawing opens (what each kind measures and how it is drawn to ISO and ASME, the pick layer, the Dimension card, and dimensions, arrowheads and turned text in the SVG, PDF and DXF writers); the shell grows 0.1 KB for the Dimension command and stays under its cap at 397.5. totalJs went from 893 to 896 for Arrange dimensions (#565): about 2.6 KB in the drawing chunk (the row layout, snapping a dragged size into a row, finding a neighbouring view the rows run into, and row spacing in Sheet settings); the shell grows 0.1 KB for the Arrange dimensions command, to 397.6. shell went from 399 to 400 and totalJs from 931 to 937 for the render film strip (#603): main was at 398.9 and 930.5. The strip, its job queue, its actions and the top bar wheel are a 5.7 KB chunk that loads only with a model that has renders or when the Render view opens; the shell grows 0.5 KB for the slot that loads it, the top bar wheel slot, the save hook and the renders store. totalJs went from 937 to 939 for More tools on the compact tool bar: the button, its state and the lazy import add about 0.1 KB to the shell, which stays under its cap at 399.4; the sheet itself (the ribbon's tabs as big buttons for phones and tablets) is a 1.5 KB chunk that loads when it opens. totalJs went from 939 to 944, and drawing from 50 to 51, for drawing view styles (shaded, rendered, line art, wireframe): about 3.6 KB of picture code (a WebGL shaded render and the path tracer framed square on to a view) and the view's Style card in the properties panel, both loaded only when a sheet has a shaded or rendered view or one is selected; the drawing chunk grows 0.8 KB for the hook that asks for the pictures, draws them under the view's lines and stops a render you no longer want. The shell grows under 0.1 KB. totalJs went from 970 to 976 for the electronics parts library (#608): about 5.5 KB in the electronics chunk, which loads only when a schematic or board opens (the Components panel's search, shelves, part card with its symbol and footprint drawings, starred and recent parts). The 228 parts themselves are a JSON file fetched when the panel first opens, not JavaScript, and the KiCad readers are not in the app yet. The electronics chunk is at 25.5 of 26: the part editors and the import that come next go in chunks of their own. totalJs went from 976 to 992 for making and importing electronics parts (#608): main was at 971.9, and this adds 18.3 KB, none of it at first paint and none when a schematic opens. The part editor and the KiCad importer (the footprint and symbol wizards, the readers for .kicad_sym and .kicad_mod, the editor's dialog) are a 14.2 KB chunk fetched when New part, Edit or Import KiCad is pressed; the Components panel moved out of the electronics chunk into its own 6.8 KB chunk with your own parts and their account sync, fetched when the panel first opens, which takes the electronics chunk from 25.5 to 23.0. The shell went from 402 to 403 for reference components (#672): main was at 401.7, and the component ghost with its Show as a reference, Show others as references and Clear references entries (about 0.3 KB, sharing Hide others' code) took it to 402.0; the electronics parts library (#673) then made 402.1. The browser rows and their menu show at first paint, so that code cannot be deferred. The drawing workspace went from 51 to 52 and totalJs from 992 to 1010 for the schematic's rules check, parts table and export (#609): exporting a schematic reuses the drawing sheet's layout, title block and writers, so that code moved out of the drawing's own chunk into ones both share (51.0 where it was 50.4, the same code plus the seams), the new cards are lazy chunks (rules check 4.0, parts table 1.4, export 3.1), and the schematic's own editing grew by about 5 (copy and paste, renumber, shorthand values, net lighting, seven more tools and commands). The electronics workspace still went down, from 23.0 to 22.7, because the board's drawing and picking (5.1) now load with the PCB view. Make external: a 1.5 KB dialog chunk and about 1.5 KB in the Insert model kernel chunk, both lazy; the shell grows about 0.2 KB for its menu entry, dialog state and lazy import.

wasm.$comment: MB. OCCT is the opencascade.js build replicad ships (23 MB); the issue's 12 MB / 3.5 MB target needs a slimmer build of the same unmodified OCCT (#4, #50).

viewport.$comment: Since #204 the view fills the 1280 x 800 window (3.3 times the pixels it had), and the frame is 34 to 84 ms on runners depending on the runner (the kernel numbers swing by the same factor in the same runs). Baseline 90 leaves the same headroom over a fast runner as the kernel budgets have.

lighthouse.$comment: Desktop preset, Chromium with SwiftShader as CI runs it. Software WebGL compiles the view's shaders on the main thread (about 1 s of blocking time); with WebGL off the score is 100. The target is 0.85. The score swings from about 0.55 to 0.73 on the same code from runner to runner, so it warns rather than blocks (performanceBlocks false): budgets.mjs reports it in the table and as a warning annotation. Installable still blocks.
